about: Lane 114 fix round 1 (review M1): one week's players both the Python record read (research/nightly/reads/record.py score_entries, printed) and the API's league ranking (api/internal/leaguerecord/ranking.go rank, roundTo) grade, with the figures both must print. A player with no stat line (z_out) is graded by neither; c_tie and d_tie tie on points; i_espn_tie ties c_tie on ESPN's projection; e_noid has no ESPN projection (no ESPN id); f_unlisted is not on our order. The lineup is the standard 12-team one, no flex. The rounding cases are half-way values both must round away from zero on the shortest decimal form.
